answer: Because the timing is written down against the basalt challenge, the anchor audit can replay the sable history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 56 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4630 identities would post 3455 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
